name: W1080 - Web - Consumer Messaging and Video Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Web upload and clipboard paste into the Consumer Messaging and Video surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before content reaches consumer chat / video apps (WhatsApp Web, Telegram, Discord, TikTok, etc.). The entire channel is treated as Unauthorized — no Authorized partner exists. Exclusions: no list-based exclusion at this layer; tune by adding user-conditions to scope down to specific user groups if a business workflow requires it.
